column5: AD_DESC

column4: Declare an emergency at the border
column5: Unlocks military construction money and troop deployments at the border.

column4: Declare an economic emergency over trade
column5: Unlocks tariffs under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.
Unlocks waivers to speed up drilling, refining and power plants.
Unlocks a pause on fossil-fuel leasing and money for clean power.
Unlocks federal deployments to cities.
National Guard and active-duty troops help patrol the border.
Children born to parents here illegally or temporarily no longer get citizenship.
Tariffs on most imports, set by the White House, using emergency powers.
No new federal hires except for security and safety.
Reclassify tens of thousands of policy jobs as at-will.

column4: Federal workers back to the office
column5: All federal employees back at their desks five days a week.
Lease offshore and federal land for oil and gas.
Shut down diversity, equity and inclusion offices and training.

column4: Ten old rules out for every new one
column5: Agencies must repeal ten rules for every new one.
Formally leave the global climate agreement.

column4: Deport gang members as alien enemies
column5: Use a 1798 wartime law to deport suspected gang members.

column4: Surge federal agents into high-crime cities
column5: Send FBI, DEA and ATF agents and federal prosecutors to the cities with the most violent crime.

column4: Cut the federal workforce by a tenth
column5: Lay off about a tenth of the civilian federal workforce.

column4: Designate the cartels as terrorist groups
column5: Treat drug cartels as foreign terrorist organizations.
Cancel up to $20,000 of federal student debt per borrower.
Rejoin the global climate agreement.

column4: Pause new oil and gas leases
column5: No new oil and gas leases on federal land and water.
Deferred action and work permits for undocumented immigrants brought here as children.
Federal contractors must pay at least $20 an hour.
Protect access to mifepristone by mail and at pharmacies.
Body cameras and use-of-force limits for federal law enforcement.
Labs training the most powerful AI models must report safety tests.
Firms that break labor law lose federal contracts.
Medicare pays no more for drugs than other rich countries do.

column4: Ban stock trading by your appointees
column5: Your political appointees can't trade individual stocks.
The FTC and Justice Department go after price gouging in food and housing.

column4: Release oil from the strategic reserve
column5: Sell oil from the reserve to bring down gas prices.

column4: Fast-track data centers on federal land
column5: Lease federal land for AI data centers and the power plants to run them.
Cut tariffs on imported food.
Power plants must capture most of their carbon by 2035.

column4: Overtime pay for four million more workers
column5: Raise the salary threshold for overtime pay.
Cap the late fees big card issuers charge.
Make most non-compete clauses unenforceable.
Minimum staffing for nursing homes paid by Medicare and Medicaid.
Prices must include all mandatory fees up front.
Treat broadband as a utility: no blocking or throttling.
Roll back tailpipe rules that push electric cars.
Roll back limits on power-plant emissions.
Adults without children must work or train to get food aid.
Lower capital requirements for big banks.
Bar most asylum claims from people who cross between ports.
Cut the wait for permits to mine critical minerals.
Hospitals must post their real prices.

column4: Tighter export controls on AI chips
column5: Stop the most advanced AI chips from reaching China.
